title: Nexus CoreHomeConfiguration
description: Home/configuration projection for the narrow home entry: resolved home roots and the currently selected creator/workspace. Carries no workspace pool, execution or Host state.

user_home.description: Raw user home this service was opened with.

nexus_home.description: Resolved .nexus42 home root (home-layout appends it exactly once).

active_creator_id.description: Currently selected creator id; null before selection.

active_workspace_slug.description: Currently selected workspace slug; null before selection.
